claim_boundary: Read-only current owned task/capacity and prospective preparation-debt bridge across the complete accepted request-window grammar. Not full TD5 operand/cost admission, a winner, execution authority, fresh skill, history choice, movement/use, or parent FT7/FT8/FT9 acceptance.
rules: All 392 prior source identities exact; no accepted paid branch or passing old test rerun. Restore saved records only. Full existing independent native/source/intake/window/payment audit precedes each bridge.

Before/partial/ready/cancelled have no current capacity or preparation output. Settled and exact restarted inputs expose byte-identical bridge. No new native commands, wallet mutation, reserve/history event or receipt.

Fresh task requirements are exactly the accepted original source required Demand, with exact family/context/cue/target. Independently prove the paid cloned task changes only the fixed priority mask, not the semantic obligations or support bounds. No caller-supplied easier demand.

Current participant view, profile and cursor must equal the accepted intake; only the already audited comparison payment suffix is permitted. Current task must remain current paid owned and oldest unresolved under the exact preserved controller prefix.

Every request differs from the first only by key and (workflow only) accessible. All optional role fields remain None. Complete grammar and per-window hashes checked. Factor only route geometry, certificate applicability and absence of support, which are independent of accessible subset under these constraints. Never factor native content eligibility, recipes, costs or nominees.

Use the unchanged IntegratedRoutePolicy admission for one representative request on the exact current native checkpoint and original preserved retention/relay. Retain all six ordered means and exact certificate reasons. Expose no selected mean or across-window nominee.

Independently reconstruct current geometry, dimensionality, wallet, recall/revocation/scoped certificates and support-none without importing the new builder, IntegratedRoutePolicy or its executor. Original paid/native/source audits remain mandatory.

Prospective preparation is max(0, exact source load - current load-v1 reserve). Bind to fresh owned task identity, never old task debt. Intake-only read/bind and comparison receipts give zero preparation credit. Do not append reserve admission or outcome history yet.

All future full TD5 cost joins must use post-comparison wallet, preserve native operand bounds and nonmonotone window domain, pay changed inputs afresh, and respect retained/ordinary/n/cp/support/defer priority. Current bridge grants no affordability or execution authority.

Adversarial controls reject forged source/domain, stale or unrelated native suffix, changed requirement/role/window, predebit wallet substitution, forged capacity/recall/authority, borrowed preparation credit and forged history/reserve prefixes.
execution: Prospectively bounded init, one record stage per exact saved key, one actual method per method stage, then aggregate finish. Completed passing stages refuse rerun. Interrupted stages preserve logs/raw and may resume saved readback without any payment. Assertion failures require diagnosed prospective correction. Each stage verifies unchanged source and accepted raw identities. All 40 saved projections, all 8 exact actual methods and all 476 exact predecessor identities mandatory.
preserved_obligations: Fresh skill, full role/operand/cost admission, genuine distinct-element ties, live history-only choice, chosen paid movement and downstream use, matched feedback-off/history-removal controls, full staging/restart, ordered pairs/populations and every FT8 denominator/matched-main-cost obligation remain mandatory.
